landing.problemSubtitle: 3 fatal gaps in the first 120-minute "golden window" after a storm hits
landing.gap1Desc: Residents are completely unprepared, unable to relocate assets or evacuate in time.
landing.gap2Desc: Slow response time, unable to determine who needs rescue first among thousands of requests.
landing.gap3Desc: Residents may inadvertently move into dangerously deep water areas.
landing.feat1Desc: RandomForest Classifier trained on 3,000 samples, processing through 200 decision trees. Classifies 4 risk levels from Low to Critical in under 0.40 seconds.
landing.feat2Desc: The system calculates "safe arc routes" instead of shortest paths — prioritizing safety at walking speed of 4km/h, completely avoiding predicted flood zones.
landing.feat3Desc: When a sensor detects water rising to 1.5m, AegisFlow activates the entire automated response chain — no manual intervention required.
landing.timelineFooter: Humans shift from "Manual Execution" to "Supervision & Approval"
landing.compareTitle: A Turning Point in Disaster Management
landing.compareRow1Aegis: AI auto-scans every 15 min. Flexible 15m–24h horizon.
landing.compareRow2Traditional: Manual dispatch via radio, easily overloaded
landing.ecosystemSubtitle: 5 closed-loop stages — from raw data to life-saving action
landing.ecoStep1Desc: IoT sensors measure water level, rainfall + OpenWeatherMap data in real-time.
landing.ecoStep2Desc: RandomForest Classifier evaluates 4 risk levels. Dual AI ensures 100% uptime.
landing.ecoStep3Desc: System auto-creates incidents, assigns rescue teams via priority algorithm.
landing.ecoStep4Desc: Push notifications via FCM, display flood-avoidance map and safe evacuation routes.
landing.ecoStep5Desc: Teams receive orders via Web UI, approach via pre-calculated safe routes.
landing.aseanSubtitle: Piloted in Da Nang — designed ready for region-wide deployment
landing.aseanCard1Desc: Ethical algorithms ensure fair response, prioritizing the most vulnerable lives (elderly, children).
landing.aseanCard2Desc: Flexible design — coordinates and alert thresholds are configurable. Supports open standards: OpenWeatherMap, GeoJSON.
landing.aseanCard3Desc: Supports Vietnamese & English. Ready to integrate Southeast Asian languages (Thai, Bahasa, Tagalog).
landing.ctaSubtitle: Unleash AI power so no one is left behind in the flood waters.
landing.ctaFooter: AegisFlow AI. The Platform Ready for ASEAN's Future.

usage.content: AegisFlow AI provides disaster monitoring and alert services. Users must be at least 16 years old and provide accurate information when registering. Using the service for illegal purposes or to harm the system is strictly prohibited.

account.title: 2. User Account
account.content: You are responsible for securing your login credentials. All activities from your account are considered performed by you. Notify us immediately if you detect unauthorized access.

liability.title: 4. Limitation of Liability

changes.title: 5. Changes to Terms
